classes.purpose: Carry out statement-analysis using the selected evidence and user instructions
classes.content: Selected long-form income-statement values, explicit row scheme and financial line labels, period/scenario mappings, computed subtotals and complete reporting table, context, diagnostic and interpretation artifacts. Local numerical/rendering code makes no separate model call. Reading original data or outputs adds those actual values to host context; no automatic anonymization is applied. Any separately requested publication uses the parent reporting route.
